text:
taylor: Quick sync 1: we've repeatedly hit trouble attributing runtime GPU spikes to specific batching choices when requests fan out across replicas. current traces show latency but no "batch ancestry" so we can't answer who contributed tokens or why fallback routing happened.
sam: saw the same. infra asks: was it a big batch from tenant A or a cascade of tiny fallbacks? neither is easy to answer today.
yara: idea: attach a compact "batch-ancestry" token that encodes the chain of batching decisions and a coarse weight for attribution. keep it below 32 bytes and never include raw ids.
taylor: requirements: 1) survive fanout & reassembly 2) avoid cardinality explosion in metrics 3) allow daily rollups for chargeback + fast diagnostic lookups for incidents 4) opt-out for private installs.
nina: security: token must be an HMAC'd compact blob. we can encode entries as: slot|w where slot=tenant_bucket:shard and w=weight_bucket(1-8). then base62 + HMAC. header name: X-RW-BATCH-ANCESTRY.
kevin: storage plan: do NOT index ancestry token in primary trace store. instead: a) short-lived diagnostic index for traces explicitly sampled_for_diag (TTL 72h) b) nightly expansion job that decodes ancestry and writes batch_ancestry_rollup_{day} keyed by {date, model, route, tenant_bucket, mode} with aggregates: total_batches, est_gpu_ms, avg_weight.
yara: also want to capture fallback chains: first_slot>fallback_slot>... Represent as semicolon-separated slot entries; only store full chain in traces when sampled. Default aggregate only uses first_slot.
sam: sampling policy: batch decisions = 100% event, ancestry token attached always; full chain + token deltas sampled at route-configurable rate (default 0.5%). this gives us ability to reconstruct examples without huge data volumes.
taylor: pseudocode for edge shim: 
```
// edge-sidecar
anc = ancestry_builder(req)
// ancestry: compact list of slot:weight e.g. s12:3;s17:1
hdr = rb64(hmac_key, anc)
req.headers.set("X-RW-BATCH-ANCESTRY", hdr)
span.root.set_tag("rw.batch_ancestry", hdr)
metric.emit("rw.batcher.choice", 1, {mode:anc.mode, model:req.model, route:req.route})
if random() < route_cfg.sample_full_chain: emit_event("rw.batch_chain", scrub(anc.full_chain))
```

nina: scrub(anc.full_chain) must remove any raw tenant identifiers and use tenant buckets only. HMAC key per-deployment so private installs can rotate or disable. config flag observability.batch_ancestry.enabled: hosted=true default, private=false default.
kevin: index cost knobs: sample_for_diag_rate controls short-lived trace indexing. recommended defaults: sample_rate=0.01 for diagnostic traces, ancestry_rollup retention 90 days.
yara: dashboards: build a tile to answer "top estimated GPU contributors by tenant_bucket" using the rollup table. include a confidence band because weight_bucket is approximate.
sam: RFC checklist I'll draft: header contract, ancestry encoding spec, sampling knobs, PII/PIA notes, rollup schema, rollout plan.
taylor: rollout plan: 1) small RFC (sam) 2) shim prototype in staging (yara+sam) 3) scrub & HMAC lib (nina) 4) rollup job + dashboard stub (kevin) 5) docs + private defaults (taylor). target: one sprint for prototype, two more for rollup.
kevin: one ops concern: we should offer a toggle to only emit ancestry token for non-PII routes. add route-level allowlist.
taylor: agreed. we'll add route.allowlist.anonymized_batch_ancestry = true/false.
nyara: (typo correction) yara: leaving branch open for comments. :+1:
